title: Answer pane follow-ups: status overwrite, answered vs new question, in-flight preview, detail strip wrap

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S127 later notes (2026-10-26): while answer tracking is on, every snapshot overwrites actionStatus, so another status message is lost on the next poll (internal/tui/pane.go:389-411); the footer can say 'answered' against a new question if the run resumes and re-pauses between snapshots (clear on a pending-text change); the Answer field preview still shows the 'ork answer ...' command while the call is in flight; the Overview detail strip wraps with a stray leading space on continuation lines (overview.go wrapText or breakAt, predates S127, visible in about 10 goldens); no blank line between the pane reason and the progress line.

S109 later notes (2026-10-26): mark the followed run's row in Overview for the 5 s of the switch notice; clear the switch notice on the first keypress in the pane; two surviving low mutations: the m.actionStatus reset in openPane and the redundant project guard in followNewestRun.

S31 screenshot (2026-10-26): a paused run's reason line ends with the CLI form 'next: ork retry RUN' while the pane hint already says 't retry'; in the TUI drop the CLI suffix.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Re-anchor from the code after S127 and S109 land. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui; go test ./internal/tui -update and review; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
